players.product: Contracted hydro, wind, solar and battery-storage power for corporate and hyperscaler buyers, plus Westinghouse nuclear fuel, services and AP1000 reactors

quarterly_data.signal: Brookfield Renewable's Q2 2026 results release and interim report, assets sold with its institutional partners (capital recycling; sale prices not recorded): signed an agreement to sell a ~570 MW portfolio of operating solar and wind assets from its European development businesses to a newly formed European renewable power platform, with a framework to sell it additional operating assets over time; closed two-thirds of the sale of ~2,100 MW of assets to the Northview Energy platform in the quarter and the remaining third after quarter end; completed the sale of an additional 25% interest in a 403 MW portfolio of non-core operating hydro assets in the U.S. (Maine); agreed to sell a portfolio of solar assets it developed and small non-core hydro assets from its Isagen business in Colombia in two transactions (held for sale at June 30, 2026: a 218 MW portfolio of operating solar and hydroelectric assets and a 39 MW portfolio of operating hydroelectric assets in Colombia); and after quarter end completed the sale of its remaining 33% interest in a 2.1 GW portfolio of operating wind and solar assets in the United States.
quarterly_data.figure: ~570 MW Europe (agreed); ~2,100 MW to Northview; 25% of a 403 MW U.S. hydro portfolio; 218 MW and 39 MW Colombia (held for sale); remaining 33% of 2.1 GW U.S. wind and solar
